subject: maths
question: R wishes to use a stick of length 6 units as common internal tangent to two circles of radius two units and three units. What can be the maximum distance (in units) between the centres of the circle?
solution:
**Given:**

Length of common internal tangent (L) = 6 units

Radius of the first circle (r₁) = 2 units

Radius of the second circle (r₂) = 3 units

**Formula used:**

For two circles with radii r₁ and r₂, and the length of the common internal tangent L, the distance d between their centers can be given by:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6832f9ac1095b2c2012cea50525f30a52ea4ebb68b8a419057700b7c4fe13d78.png] 

sqrt{d² - (r₁ + r₂)²} = L

**Calculation:**

sqrt{d² - (2 + 3)²} = 6

⇒ sqrt{d² - 25} = 6

⇒ sqrt{d² - 25} = 6

⇒ (d² - 25) = 6²

⇒ (d² - 25) = 36

⇒ d² = 36 + 25

⇒ d = sqrt{61}

**∴ The correct answer is option 1.**
